methods.name: Growing Split-Based Approach (GSBA)
methods.summary: A bottom-up change detection algorithm that splits an image into tiles, identifies tiles with changes, and grows patches within tile clusters until a consistent bimodal histogram is reached. It calculates Bayesian probability maps of changes based on Gaussian parameters derived from the histograms, and selects the final change map using Ripley's K index.
methods.source: Lin, Y.N.; Chen, Y.-C.; Kuo, Y.-T.; Chao, W.-A.
methods.verbatim: The calculation of 2D degree of polarization and scattering powers is carried out in PolSAR-tools available at https://github.com/Narayana-Rao/PolSAR-tools (accessed on 10 March 2022).
